spanish: Y el alzante el cadáver de ellos lavará sus vestidos, y se impurecerá hasta la tarde; impuros ellos a ustedes.
grammarChanges: su cadáver → el cadáver de ellos: נִבְלָתָם carries a 3mp suffix ('their' carcass); 'su' after the singular 'alzante' (3ms participle) misread as the lifter's own carcass, so the plural possessor is now stated explicitly to keep it distinct from the singular subject.
readerNote: Chose 'el cadáver de ellos' over 'su cadáver' so the 3mp possessor of the carcass is not misread as the singular alzante's own carcass.
